svg.text: Same recipe throughout: BASE (dark shade, full) + FACE (top-aligned, shorter) + SHEEN (hugs top edge). Circular = 52px, square = 56px, wall 12px.
Dark utility variant uses panel #12171C over #050709 so it recedes; colored variants use their own shade pair.

g.text: CTA WITH COST · price lives inside

svg.text: · Circular icon buttons 52px (r26/20, wall 12). Square icon buttons 56px (r18/13, wall 12). FAB 68px (r34/27, wall 14).

· Colour by intent — DARK PANEL for neutral utility (back, settings, menu, info, stats) · VOLT for forward/confirm · BLAZE for destructive (close, quit) · COURT BLUE for tertiary · BUBBLEGUM for social.
· Dark utility buttons keep a 12% sheen so they still read as pressable; volt uses 40%, blaze 30%, court 20%.
· Badges (count, rank) always straddle the outer edge at the top-right or bottom-right. Never inside the face.
· Toggles: the knob is its own mini stack (base + face + sheen) so it reads as a physical switch. OFF loses all colour and sheen.
· Icon strokes 4–4.5px round-capped at 52px. Never thinner than 3px at any size — thin strokes break the style instantly.
